easy.def: A plant that you eat, like a carrot.
examples: I eat my vegetables.
A carrot is a vegetable.
Vegetables are good for you.

more.def: A plant or part of a plant that people eat, such as a carrot, a bean or a potato.
examples: Carrots and peas are vegetables.
She grew vegetables in the garden.
We had soup full of vegetables.

easy.def: A thing that takes people from place to place, like a car or bus.
examples: A truck is a big vehicle.
A bus is a vehicle for many people.
The vehicle has four wheels.

more.def: A machine such as a car, bus, or truck that carries people or things.
examples: Only emergency vehicles may park in front of the hospital.
A bicycle is a vehicle with two wheels.
The road was closed to all vehicles during the parade.
I read the short version of the story.
This version is newer.
She wrote her own version.

more.def: A form of something that is a little different from others.
examples: The movie is a new version of an old fairy tale.
The new version of the game has better graphics.
Each person told a different version of what happened.
I am very happy.
The ice is very cold.
She ran very fast.

more.def: To a high degree, or extremely.
examples: The whale is a very large animal.
It was a very quiet night in the forest.
He was very proud of his drawing.
The vessel sailed.
A vessel is in the bay.
The vessel was big.
The vessel sailed out of the harbor.
A fishing vessel returned at dawn.
The huge vessel carried goods across the ocean.

easy.def: A bowl or bottle for water.
examples: A vase is a vessel.
The vessel holds water.
Put the water in the vessel.

more.def: A container such as a bowl or bottle, used for holding liquid.
examples: A jug is a vessel for carrying water.
The potter made a clay vessel.
Pour the milk into a clean vessel.
